description: This file defines the NatsAdapterFactory class, which implements the IQueueAdapterFactory interface for creating and managing NATS-based queue adapters within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It handles initialization, adapter creation, cache management, and provides mechanisms for delivery failure handling.

classes.name: NatsAdapterFactory
classes.description: Implements a factory for creating NATS-based queue adapters in Orleans streaming, managing configuration, caching, and failure handling.

methods.name: NatsAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with configuration options, serializer, and logger factory.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting up the default stream failure handler if not set.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new NATS connection manager and returns a new NatsAdapter instance.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache used for queue adapters.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Provides a failure handler for a specified queue.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a new instance of NatsAdapterFactory using dependency injection.
